name: Giant Crocodile
summary: A huge crocodile that bites and sweeps with its tail.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The crocodile makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape {dc=15}). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the crocodile's Tail.

actions.name: Tail
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
